speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are in the door, Alse. The washing can wait on the chair.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Mistress said set it down and go. I heard you walking. I have not seen a play, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then hear the oath, and not the rest of it. Three years' study.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Three years is a long time to be at a book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One meal a day.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: One meal. That is a thin table for a man who is shouting an oath.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And no woman within a mile of the court.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then they'll starve, sir. Who's to cook?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the oath. They swear it, and they mean it, for as long as the scene allows them.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Who brings the one meal, if she cannot come inside the mile?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They have not asked. They are busy being solemn.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: A solemn man still wants his supper. At home we would have the hog in by now. Here you buy it in pieces. Somebody cooks the pieces.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse! He is not to be encouraged after eight.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: She will have me down. Say the mile again. I want to be sure I heard the mistake.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No woman within a mile of the court. You heard it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then the cook is a mile off, and the meal is one, and the years are three. They will be very thin and very clean.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The ladies come anyway. That is the next thing. You have already found the first hole.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I was not looking for a hole, sir. I was looking for who puts the pot on.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Who puts the pot on is the hole.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Do they know it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They will. Not in the first minute. You were quicker than the scene.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Mistress is on the stair. I can hear the board creak.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse. Down. The washing is not a play, and he is not a kitchen.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am coming. Three years, and one meal, and nobody to cook it. I shall remember it wrong on purpose, and I shall remember that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Remember the cook. The rest is verse, and verse can wait until tomorrow.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Good night, sir. The washing is on the chair, as you said, and I am not taking it up again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night, Alse. Tell her I heard her the first time.
